symptom: mxcli lint SEC012 (ReachablePageNotReadable) reported 19 CE2729 errors on an 11.15 project where mx check reported 0: every one was data inside a container with `Visible: roles (…)` limited to module roles that may read it.
file: mdl/linter/rules/reachable_page_read_access.go roleVisibility.hidden / restrictsAway / refersTo (unit ids from loadReachModel). Test: mdl/linter/rules/reachable_page_role_visibility_2356_test.go
cause: The rule works from catalog refs, which say a page uses an entity or attribute but not in which widget, so a widget's ConditionalVisibilitySettings.ModuleRoles never reached it; mxbuild does not check read access for a widget the user role cannot see.
insight: **When a lint rule mirrors an mxbuild check, measure both directions on one page.** 11.12.6: a data grid over an attribute the role may not read, inside a container `visible: roles (Admin)` — mx check 0 errors, SEC012 now 0 (was 1); the same container `visible: roles (Admin, User)` — CE2729 and SEC012 both 1. The catalog cannot answer per-widget questions; the stored widget tree (LintReader.GetRawUnit) can, and the finding is suppressed only when every occurrence is under a restriction that excludes all of the user role's module roles — an unreadable unit or no occurrence keeps the finding.
